title: Pair all comparisons
frozenQuestion: Can scenario and valid semantic-stream coupling reduce variance without changing marginal treatment distributions?

inputBank.permutationRule: Reuse each immutable S07 initial occupancy and value vector exactly across every arm in its pairing block; generate no replacement permutation in S08.

pairingBlock.unit: one S07 input scenario crossed with one homogeneous Algotype assignment and one target direction
pairingBlock.algotypeRule: Every cell in a profile receives the named executable policy; all three profiles are fully crossed with every input rather than sampled.
pairingBlock.directionRule: Both directions are fully crossed with every input and Algotype profile.
pairingBlock.armComposition: Every pairing block supports every executable arm in contrast_arm_catalog.json; the Cartesian block-by-arm run list is intentionally normalized and not materialized in S08.

faultMapAssignment.profileAllocation: Within each split-by-n-by-valueProfile-by-orderStructure stratum, rank inputScenarioId by a counter-addressed S08 assignment hash and cycle through a stratum-rotated 12-profile class-by-count list. Counts among profiles differ by at most one whenever the stratum has at least 12 rows.
faultMapAssignment.mapGeneration: Apply the frozen S06 structural generator to the initial-position identity/value context with one selected class and exact count per S07 input.
faultMapAssignment.sharing: The selected map is shared across Algotype, direction, architecture, scheduler, continuation, retry, coordinator, and passive-versus-stuck comparisons for the same input. Normal arms retain the map reference but apply zero faults.
faultMapAssignment.confirmatoryRule: Confirmatory maps are generated from input-only state and frozen addresses; no protected outcome, search score, search history, or S06 search-derived map may be read or assigned.

primaryContrastRules.informationBoundaryDecision: E02-S01-E07 is retained in the catalog as unpaired_non_executable_preserved_information_boundary. S02 rejects full_global_state from the matched action interface and S03 retains central_global_legacy only as a descriptive bundle; S08 does not weaken that boundary.
primaryContrastRules.retryCaveat: E02-S01-E05 remains paired as frozen, but its S01 fixed action_failure=none makes retry_later_bounded exposure inactive under the S05 rule that queues retries only after exogenous action failure. S08 does not alter the factor to manufacture an effect.
primaryContrastRules.armMarginalRule: Every executable arm is available once per pairing block. Therefore arm counts and all baseline-stratum marginals are identical within each estimand; interactions have complete four-cell support.
primaryContrastRules.assignmentTiming: The arm catalog and all block-level assignments are frozen before any S10/S11 outcome execution.

splitAndOutcomeAccess.screening_pool: assign and validate; no outcome execution in S08
splitAndOutcomeAccess.confirmatory_holdout: assign input-only fields while preserving protected=true; do not execute or inspect outcomes
splitAndOutcomeAccess.runtime_validation: may execute bounded implementation-only coupling fixtures; excluded from effect estimation

identifiers.faultMapId: the frozen S06 fp1 content identifier
identifiers.scenarioVariantId: sv1:SHA256(pairingBlockId, mobility profile, faultMapId or none); this is an S08 design identity, not an executable reference-simulator r1 scenario ID

escalationTriggers: any pairing rule changes a treatment-arm marginal distribution
any protected or search outcome is opened
any S06 search-derived or outcome-selected map is assigned
any incompatible scheduler or fault random-consumption pattern is labeled exact coupled
any need to change S02-S07 legal actions, information permissions, scheduler semantics, fault semantics, replay, RNG, or opportunity accounting
